name: intechral-client-portal-dev
description: Developer scripts for the Intechral Client Portal dev environment

scripts.restart: docker compose down && docker compose up -d
scripts.setup:
npm run build && docker compose up -d && docker compose exec app cp .env.example .env && docker compose exec app composer install && docker compose exec app php artisan key:generate && docker compose exec app php artisan migrate --seed && docker compose exec app npm install && docker compose exec app npm run build && echo "
  Setup complete. Open http://localhost:8080
"
scripts.fresh: docker compose exec app php artisan migrate:fresh --seed
scripts.test: docker compose exec app php artisan test
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d && docker compose exec app npm install && docker compose exec app npm run dev
